scope: Read-only browser-automation transport diagnosis plus one user-authorized habit-click replay.

interpretation.proven: The agent-controlled Browser Use surface blocks API transport before the application can observe the request.
not_proven: A defect in an ordinary end-user browser
interpretation.decision: No production API rename, proxy, duplicate route, security relaxation, or visual change was made solely to bypass the test-surface guard.

next_required_evidence: Run one bounded A/B write-and-history replay in a controlled user runtime not subject to the agent browser API-request guard, then bind it to the currently deployed private version.
